status: Prospective scheduling amendment, before Mistral/Phi test generation

operational_amendment.authorized_scope: Explicit prospective override of the original serial-inference scheduling wording, limited to request ordering, isolated endpoint and benchmark-selected concurrency. Frozen source files are preserved, linked by hash below. Scientific tasks, prompts, decoding parameters, seeds, checkers and analyses are unchanged.
operational_amendment.decision: Any observed controller power pause invalidates the performance comparison. After primary exit run the frozen four-way operational benchmark on an isolated server. Adopt serial, one_per_model or two_per_model only from the helper selected_mode field and its frozen paired wall-time, token-comparability, memory and zero-error gates. No scientific outcomes control mode selection.
operational_amendment.failed_gate: A normally completed negative performance gate selects serial or one_per_model as specified by the frozen benchmark. Any failed/incomplete request benchmark halts and terminates the owned isolated server.
operational_amendment.selection_protection: Mistral scientific timing and sample-size freeze run alone. Phi starts only after TEST_PROTOCOL.json and one completed Mistral test-call record, or after Mistral exits/skips.
operational_amendment.concurrency: At most two generation clients and benchmark-selected one or two requests per model; never duplicate a whole experiment. Detector scoring and length wait until both clients exit, successful unload plus absent residency confirms model drain, and the owned isolated server exits.
operational_amendment.budgets: Original Mistral/Phi wall-clock budget rules and absolute global deadline remain unchanged; power pauses do not extend deadlines.
operational_amendment.exclusion: All versions hold the original continuation/controller.lock for their entire lifetime. V2 does not stop V1; root performs the reviewed wait-primary handover.
operational_amendment.safety: Each generation child has a separate session, exact creation-time/command identity and persistent record. Any ambiguous live identity halts further work. Cleanup visits every owned child, not only the inherited current field.
operational_amendment.statistics: Scheduling decisions use only operational timing, errors, output-token counts and memory. No scientific outcomes are consulted.

isolated_server.ownership: Separate controller-owned process group, paused with children on battery and terminated on cleanup or absolute deadline. Original shared server is never signaled or reconfigured.

known_evidence: An initial conditional benchmark ran while Gemma remained active. Its foreground makespan reduction is not a full-queue speedup estimate.
pending_evidence: No four-way benchmark result or prospective Mistral/Phi test result exists at this staging checkpoint.
privacy: Live process identifiers, machine-specific identities, full dependency chains, raw prose, response records, human ratings and Drive identifiers are omitted.
